title: Battle of Tours / Poitiers
summary: Frankish forces under Charles Martel defeat an Umayyad raid in west-central Gaul.

title: Battle of Talas
summary: Abbasid and Tang forces clash in Central Asia; Chinese prisoners are later linked to paper-making in the Islamic world.

title: An Lushan rebellion
summary: A general’s revolt nearly destroys the Tang and kills a vast share of the registered population.

title: Founding of Baghdad
summary: Al-Mansur founds Baghdad as the Abbasid capital, soon a world city of learning and trade.

title: Viking raid on Lindisfarne
summary: Seaborne attackers sack the monastery of Lindisfarne, a conventional start for the Viking Age in Britain.

title: Heian period begins
summary: The court moves to Heian-kyō (Kyoto), opening a classical age of Japanese court culture.

title: Abbasid Caliphate
summary: Abbasid rule, at first imperial and later often symbolic, from the overthrow of the Umayyads to the Mongol sack of Baghdad.
